raw: {"verdict": "pass", "reason": "createBooking now takes a per-master Postgres advisory transaction lock, which works across app servers. It then checks for an overlapping confirmed booking (start < new end and end > new start) before inserting, and returns slot_taken (the 409 path) on a clash. Only confirmed bookings block time, other masters use a different lock key, and a test covers overlapping starts. One risk: only createBooking is changed, so any other path that creates or moves confirmed bookings (such as rescheduling) is not covered."}
